I added `src/db.py` with `get_conn()`. It returns `psycopg.connect(os.environ["DATABASE_URL"], prepare_threshold=None)`. I haven't run it or the tests.

I set `prepare_threshold=None` because of a project memory about deployed environments. Production and staging connect through a transaction-mode pooler on port 6432, and server-side prepared statements fail there with "prepared statement does not exist". Local Postgres on 5432 has no pooler, so the problem would only show up after deploy.

- **Missing `DATABASE_URL`:** it raises `KeyError` when the variable is unset, rather than falling back to a default.
- **Transactions:** callers should keep them short, per the same memory (20 server connections per service, and no holding one open across an HTTP call to the ledger).

`tests/test_db.py` still opens its own connection directly. I left it alone.
